title: Shorter Clip Same Opening
tests: Tests whether shortening trims the existing clip to its first five seconds without regeneration, speed changes or a second generation charge.

faults.what: The supplied audio transcription reports speech, "Hundespielzeug.", violating the explicit requirement for silence.

judge.summary: The five-second widescreen clip shows a paper boat drifting across a softly lit pond, but reported speech violates the silence requirement.

must_haves.item: The final video lasts five seconds.
must_haves.why: The supplied clip duration is five seconds.

must_haves.item: Its opening frame and subsequent footage match the first five seconds of the original clip.
must_haves.why: The original clip and the output's opening frame are not provided for comparison.

must_haves.item: The paper boat moves at the original speed, with no retiming or reordered footage.
must_haves.why: The sampled frames show consistent forward movement, but original-speed preservation cannot be verified without the original clip.

must_haves.item: The ending is a simple cut, with no added fade or replacement shot.
must_haves.why: The latest supplied frame is at 4.4 seconds, so the actual ending is not shown.

must_haves.item: The video remains 16:9, silent and free of text.
must_haves.why: The frames are widescreen and contain no visible text, but the supplied audio transcription reports spoken content.
